content: The x-stance dataset has more German samples than French samples. The language ratio of about 3:1 is consistent across all training and test sets. Given the two languages it is possible to either train two monolingual models or to train a single model in a multi-source setup BIBREF16. We choose a multi-source baseline because M-Bert is known to benefit from multilingual training data both in a supervised and in a cross-lingual scenario BIBREF17.
